D: Two men wake up chained in a filthy bathroom, part of a killer's twisted game.
P: Serve the snacks when the first tape starts playing.
S: Choose your fate chip and dip
Chive sour cream, smoked red pepper and habanero tomato dips, mild to hot
Three dips, mild to very hot: sour cream and chive, roasted capsicum with smoked paprika, and a habanero salsa. Corn chips to dip and decide.

Crisp homemade cheddar and jalapeño crackers cut into jigsaw pieces, baked golden and served with a smoky red capsicum and walnut dip. Pulse 150g plain flour, 150g grated sharp cheddar, 60g cold butter, 1 chopped pickled jalapeño and a pinch of salt until crumbly, then add 2 tbsp cold water to bring it together. Roll 3mm thick between baking paper, cut into jigsaw shapes and bake at 180C for 15 minutes until golden. Blend 200g roasted capsicum, 60g toasted walnuts, 1 tsp smoked paprika, 1 tbsp pomegranate molasses and 2 tbsp olive oil for the dip.
Yeast doughnuts with a coffee glaze

Soft yeasted ring doughnuts fried golden and dipped in a strong espresso glaze, half rolled in cinnamon sugar instead, for a long night on watch. Mix 500g plain flour, 7g dried yeast, 50g caster sugar and a pinch of salt, then add 250ml warm milk, 2 eggs and 50g soft butter and knead 8 minutes. Prove 1 hour. Roll 1.5cm thick, cut 12 rings and prove 30 minutes. Fry at 175C for 1 minute a side and drain. Whisk 200g icing sugar with 3 tbsp hot espresso for the glaze. Dip half the doughnuts and toss the rest in cinnamon sugar while warm.
M: Detective Tapp's beef chilli con carne
the detectives who won't let it go

Chuck steak and kidney beans slow-cooked with chipotle, cumin and tomato until thick and smoky, topped with sour cream, cheddar and pickled jalapeños, with corn chips. Brown 1kg diced chuck steak in batches. Add 2 diced onions and 3 garlic cloves and cook for 5 minutes. Stir in 2 tsp ground cumin, 2 tsp smoked paprika and 2 chopped chipotles in adobo, then 2 tins crushed tomatoes and 250ml beef stock. Cover and simmer for 2.5 hours until the beef falls apart. Add 1 drained tin kidney beans for the last 20 minutes. Serve with sour cream, grated cheddar, pickled jalapeños and corn chips.
Roast chicken with roast potatoes and gravy, steamed vegetables
Roast chicken with lemon and thyme at 220C then 180C, rested, with roast potatoes, green beans and pan gravy.
W: Red velvet cupcakes with cream cheese frosting
Red velvet cupcakes baked at 175C for 18 minutes, cream cheese frosting piped in a spiral, a dot of red on top.
K: One jug of lemon mint lemonade, one of sugar free lime and soda, take your pick
Two jugs: sweet lemonade with mint, and a sharp lime soda with no sugar at all.

dishes.n: Choose your fate chip and dip

steps.text: Mix some of the sour cream with the chives for the mild dip.
Blitz the capsicum with more sour cream and the paprika for the medium dip.
Blitz the tomatoes with the habanero and salt for the hot dip.
Line them up mild to hot with the corn chips.

dishes.make_ahead: Best eaten the day they are made

steps.text: Mix the flour, yeast, sugar and salt, add the milk, eggs and butter and knead for 8 minutes.
Prove for 1 hour.
Roll 1.5cm thick, cut into rings and prove for 30 minutes.
Fry in the oil at 175C for 1 minute a side and drain.
Whisk the icing sugar with the espresso for the glaze. Dip half the doughnuts and toss the rest in cinnamon sugar while warm.

dishes.make_ahead: Rub the chicken with the butter, lemon and thyme up to 1 day ahead and keep it uncovered in the fridge; roast, make the gravy and steam the beans on the night

steps.text: Rub the chicken with butter, lemon and thyme.
Roast at 220C for 20 minutes, then at 180C for 50 minutes with the potatoes.
Rest the chicken and make gravy from the pan juices and stock.
Steam the beans and serve.

veg.n: Dr Gordon's lentil loaf roast dinner
veg.make_ahead: Shape the loaf up to 1 day ahead

ingredients.item: tins brown lentils (400 g each), drained

steps.text: Fry the onion and mushrooms in 1 tbsp of the oil until dry. Mash the lentils roughly and mix with the mushrooms, breadcrumbs, eggs, lemon zest and thyme leaves.
Press into a lined loaf tin, brush the top with the butter and bake at 180C for 50 minutes with the potatoes tossed in the remaining oil alongside.
Rest the loaf and make gravy from the flour, stock and a squeeze of lemon.
Steam the beans and serve.

dishes.make_ahead: Bake the cupcakes up to 1 day ahead, airtight; beat the cream cheese icing and pipe on the day

steps.text: Beat the butter and sugar, add the eggs, then fold in the flour, cocoa, buttermilk and colouring.
Spoon into a muffin tin and bake at 175C for 18 minutes. Cool.
Beat the cream cheese with the icing sugar and pipe in a spiral.

dishes.make_ahead: Juice the lemons and limes and make the sugar syrup up to 2 days ahead in the fridge; add the water, soda water, ice and mint to serve

steps.text: Make one jug with lemon juice, sugar syrup and mint, topped with cold water.
Make the other with lime juice and soda water, no sugar.
Fill glasses with ice, pour from either jug and let everyone choose.

s.n: Choose your fate chip and dip
s.note: Chive sour cream, smoked red pepper and habanero tomato dips, mild to hot
s.how: Mix 150g sour cream with chives. Blitz a roasted red capsicum with 100g sour cream and smoked paprika. Blitz 2 tomatoes with a habanero and salt. Line them up mild to hot with a 300g bag of corn chips.

s.note: Yeast doughnuts with a coffee glaze
s.how: Mix 500g plain flour, 7g dried yeast, 50g caster sugar and a pinch of salt, then add 250ml warm milk, 2 eggs and 50g soft butter and knead 8 minutes. Prove 1 hour. Roll 1.5cm thick, cut 12 rings and prove 30 minutes. Fry at 175C for 1 minute a side and drain. Whisk 200g icing sugar with 3 tbsp hot espresso for the glaze. Dip half the doughnuts and toss the rest in cinnamon sugar while warm.

m.note: Roast chicken with roast potatoes and gravy, steamed vegetables
m.how: Rub a 1.8kg chicken with butter, lemon and thyme. Roast at 220C for 20 minutes then 180C for 50 minutes with 1kg potatoes. Rest and make gravy with 300ml stock. Steam 300g green beans.

w.note: Red velvet cupcakes with cream cheese frosting
w.how: Beat 125g butter and 200g sugar, add 2 eggs, then fold in 200g self-raising flour, 2 tbsp cocoa, 200ml buttermilk and red colouring. Bake 12 at 175C for 18 minutes. Pipe 250g cream cheese beaten with 250g icing sugar in a spiral.

d.note: One jug of lemon mint lemonade, one of sugar free lime and soda, take your pick
d.how: Make one jug with the juice of 4 lemons, 120g sugar syrup and mint, topped with cold water. Make the other with the juice of 4 limes and soda water, no sugar. Let everyone choose.
